'''Handro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. She served the [[Sith Empire/Legends|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]], and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to Imperials on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Handro appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Medium Armor Vendor for Imperial players on Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> she was removed from the game along with the rest of the Medium Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
